scientific_integrity: Unlimited-dimension claims rely on a written combinatorial proof; finite checks are supplementary and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only Boolean hypercubes in dimension at least two; no classification of all optimal colourings, no independently certified bibliographic priority. Prior perfect-colouring work already provides a valid seven-dimensional three-colour upper bound; the unrestricted five-dimensional obstruction is separate.
title: Sharp strong-majority vertex-colouring numbers of Boolean hypercubes
